Berlin, August 31, 2026 – Cameras have started rolling.


Dolly


(working title) is the new six-part series from the creators of Kleo - Hanno Hackfort, Richard Kropf, and Bob Konrad (HaRiBo) - and produced by BetaBerlin Productions GmbH in cooperation with Candy Shop GmbH. Filming will continue through the winter. After successfully wrapping the shooting block in Görlitz, where the historic city center served as the backdrop for the late 19th century, the team is now continuing work in the Berlin-Brandenburg region.


Berlin, 1899: When the rebellious Dolly Pinkus narrowly escapes a serial killer and the authorities fail to act, she takes the investigation into her own hands. Together with her best friend Mieze and young police inspector Carl, she embarks on a dangerous hunt for the perpetrator.
